title: WhyNoIPv6 — Dual-Stack Performance
description: Is IPv6 slower? TTFB over v4 vs v6 for dual-stacked sites, the penalty distribution, and content parity — measurement data nobody else publishes at this scale.

panels.title: Median TTFB v4 / v6 / delta
panels.description: Median time-to-first-byte across dual-stacked domains (latest confirmed scan values). delta = v6 − v4: positive means IPv6 is slower.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_v4_ms) AS v4, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_v6_ms) AS v6, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms) AS delta FROM domain WHERE latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: IPv6 faster
panels.description: Dual-stacked domains where v6 beats v4 by more than 20 ms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms < latency_v4_ms - 20)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) AS share FROM domain WHERE latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: IPv6 slower
panels.description: Dual-stacked domains where v6 trails v4 by more than 20 ms — the real-world penalty story.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms > latency_v4_ms + 20)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) AS share FROM domain WHERE latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Measured domains
panels.description: Domains with both v4 and v6 TTFB samples — the population behind every number here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS measured FROM domain WHERE latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Content parity failures
panels.description: Dual-stacked domains serving observably different content over v6 than v4 (parity check unsupported).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS mismatches FROM domain WHERE parity_observed = 'unsupported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: v6 − v4 TTFB delta distribution
panels.description: Where dual-stacked domains land on the penalty spectrum. A healthy internet clusters in ±10 ms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms < -100) AS "v6 faster >100ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms >= -100 AND latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms < -10) AS "v6 faster 10-100ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms >= -10 AND latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms <= 10) AS "parity ±10ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms > 10 AND latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms <= 100) AS "v6 slower 10-100ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_v6_ms - latency_v4_ms > 100) AS "v6 slower >100ms" FROM domain WHERE latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Average TTFB over time
panels.description: Daily averages from the scan hypertable (scans where the respective latency check ran). Keep the range modest — this scans raw scan rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, avg(latency_v4_ms) AS v4, avg(latency_v6_ms) AS v6 FROM scan WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: v6 penalty by country (≥1000 measured)
panels.description: Median v6 − v4 delta per attributed country. Big positive medians usually mean tunneled or under-peered v6 in that region.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS country, count(*) AS measured, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.latency_v6_ms - d.latency_v4_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "median delta ms" FROM domain d JOIN country c ON c.id = d.country_id WHERE d.latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND d.latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.disabled GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: v6 penalty by hosting (≥1000 measured)
panels.description: Median delta per hosting/CDN tag. CDNs should sit at ~0; a platform with a consistent positive delta has a v6 routing problem worth publishing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(d.hosting_provider, 'unattributed') AS hosting, count(*) AS measured, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.latency_v6_ms - d.latency_v4_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "median delta ms" FROM domain d WHERE d.latency_v4_ms IS NOT NULL AND d.latency_v6_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.disabled GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Response parity
panels.description: Does the site serve the same content over v6 as v4? partial = minor differences (headers/redirects), unsupported = observably different response.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE parity_observed = 'supported') AS same, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parity_observed = 'partial') AS minor_diff, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parity_observed = 'unsupported') AS different FROM domain WHERE parity_observed IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled
